plugins.name: ai-look-up
plugins.description: Detects aimless AI grinding (repeated commands, failure loops, long runs with no output) and injects mid-run self-review nudges plus real local-time anchors via hooks. v0.7 adds an out-of-host review channel: the hook writes a delivery request and an independent watcher process (own API key) returns the verdict.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 检测 AI 长时间空跑(重复命令、连续失败、只跑不产出),在运行中途注入自我审查提醒;并定期注入真实本地时间,校准 AI 的时间感。v0.7 增加第三通道:钩子写投递请求,宿主外的独立 watcher(自带 key)异步审查并回注结论,主代理全程不在链路上。含 /lookup-review、/lookup-status、/lookup-config、/lookup-watch 四个命令。
